Images were resampled every 2.5 mm using 4th degree spline interpolation to obtain isovoxels and then smoothed with a 6 mm full-width at half-maximum (FWHM) Gaussian kernel to accommodate inter-subject variation in brain anatomy and to increase signal-to-noise ratio in the images.

description.value: fMRI images were slice-time corrected, motion corrected and realigned to each participant's mean image. The mean image was co-registered with the anatomical scan, data were normalized to MNI space, resampled to 2.5 mm isotropic voxels, and smoothed with a 6 mm FWHM Gaussian kernel. Data were high-pass filtered at 128 s and autocorrelation was modeled as an AR(1) process.
